officialText:
The commissioner shall have authority to modify the requirements of any precept when such commissioner shall be satisfied that such change will secure the safety of such structure or premises equally well.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
